test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people in each row, in such a way that there is an equal distance between adjacent persons. Row 1 contains A, B, C and D, all of whom are facing south. Row 2 contains P, Q, R and S, all of whom are facing north. Thus, each person faces another person in the other row. Only two people sit between P and Q. A faces the person sitting to the immediate left of P. R sits to the immediate left of S. D sits to the immediate right of C. Who among the following faces P?
solution:
Row 1 contains A, B, C and D, all of whom are facing south. Row 2 contains P, Q, R and S, all of whom are facing north. 

1. Only two people sit between P and Q.

2. R sits to the immediate left of S. 

3. A faces the person sitting to the immediate left of P.

4. D sits to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b79647de2a1b7e33a37c44af804dde27482c19a2540d3fc5a81e9de06b6ba413.png] 

B faces P.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
